'''Internal dampeners''' were installed in the [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] shaft of the [[BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax/Legends|BD-1 Cutter]] [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]. The dampeners absorbed the vibrations created by the [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic generator]] in the [[Axe/Legends|axe]] head.<ref name="EGWT" />
